faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Andhra University for hiring a Project Fellow in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Fellow - Structural Reliability Engineer under project-based research work.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Fellow position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelors of Engineering, Master of Technology, or PhD in Mechanical, Structural, Naval Architecture, Ocean, Reliability, Computational Engineering, or related disciplines with a first-class academic record.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Fellow position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Through which mode should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their resumes and copies of relevant certificates through email to the designated address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application email be sent?
faq.answer: Applications and required documents must be emailed directly to [email protected] on or before the specified deadline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Andhra University Project Fellow?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of candidates based on their applications and qualifications, followed by an interview for shortlisted applicants.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates visit to check the official updates or website?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official Andhra University website at www.andhrauniversity.edu.in for further announcements and recruitment updates.
